messages:
Maya: Packaging heads-up: building private-installer v1.9.3 for VPC/onprem. submanifest signed with rotated cosign key. Need a canary window tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. Anyone object?

jay: quick q — did you pin our base image tags for the k8s operator? want to avoid floating `latest`.

Maya: yes pinned to `rci-2026-03-19@sha256:9f7a...e3`. Added shrinkwrap tag `private-v1.9.3-pin`.

ops-liz: FYI security flagged CVE-2026-0421 in the sidecar; upstream patch out. how long to rebuild that image?

Maya: rebuilding sidecar now, will push new image and update submanifest. this will delay canary ~+1h if that's acceptable.

sarah: i'd prefer the delay. don't want a canary with a known vuln. :+1:

release-manager: hold — update release notes with CVE and mitigation steps. also we need an explicit rollback playbook in the notes: 1) pin previous submanifest 2) force image tags back 3) run smoke tests and clear caches.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for 1919030000 (canary) — runbook: private-installer.canary -> images pinned -> cosign verify -> audit logs. Will post status updates.

Maya: updated release notes https://redwood.internal/releases/1919001234 and pushed new submanifest. checksums are attached: 

```
private-installer-v1.9.3.tar.gz sha256: abcdef1234567890deadbeefcafebabe1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef
sidecar:v2.4.2 sha256: 1234567890abcdefcafebabedeadbeef0987654321fedcba0987654321fedcba
operator:rci-2026-03-19 sha256: 9f7a6b5c4d3e2f1a0b9c8d7e6f5a4b3c2d1e0f9a8b7c6d5e4f3a2b1c0d9e8f7a
```

ops-liz: cosign signature validated ok locally (`cosign verify --key kms://...`). I also sanity-checked the new sidecar image in staging.

jay: confirm rollback procedure was tested in staging? we don't want surprises.

sarah: manual rollback tested in staging last night, worked end-to-end. small tweak needed in `hooks/post-rollback` to clear cache — patched and pushed.

release-manager: ok set canary window 02:00-05:00 UTC and @ops-liz as oncall. If >5% error rate or control-plane timeouts occur, execute the rollback steps. everyone ack?

ops-liz: ack, i'll be oncall for the window.

Maya: scheduling deploy-bot for 1919033600 (02:00 UTC). tagging release artifacts in registry and artifactory. deploy-bot, please emit start/done pings and the per-step checksums.

deploy-bot: acknowledged. will post start ping to #eng-releases at deploy time and status pings every 15m. will attach verification output: `cosign verify` + `sha256sum` checks.

sarah: added a console advisory recommending customers pin `private-v1` until we finish the patch rollout.

release-manager: final ack from PM/security. go ahead. :shipit: 

Maya: thanks — kicking off the build + push now, will report back when deploy-bot posts the start ping.
